1	/-

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not prove that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme, and it reserves `DivRankOneOpen` for the
    21	future actual open subscheme of the divisor representer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
    60	
    61	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
    62	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
    63	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    64	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
    65	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    66	
    67	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
    68	representer. -/
    69	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    70	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    71	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    72	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    73	
    74	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    75	def rankOneAbelAff :
    76	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
    77	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    78	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    79	
    80	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    81	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    82	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    83	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
    84	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    85	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    86	
    87	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    88	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    89	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    90	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    91	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
    92	
    93	end
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeFibreH1
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisorsClass
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# DAT-C C0 — the datum inverse, the divisor datum, and the canonical section
    11	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-1 + §2 (N2))
    12	
    13	Every landed datum built from a divisor family is the *twisted ideal* datum
    14	`𝒪(Θᵃ − d)` of class `θᵃ·[d]⁻¹` (G-0a). DAT-C's normalization layer needs a datum in
    15	the class `[𝒪(d)]` itself, together with its canonical section. This file pins both:
    16	
    17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.inv` — the **datum inverse**: same cover
    18	  data, transition units `(g i j)⁻¹`; the cocycle law inverts termwise.
    19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_inv` — the class law
    20	  `D.inv.cechPicClass = D.cechPicClass⁻¹` (subordinated-cocycle level).
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relThetaCocycle_zero`, `FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero`,
    22	  `thetaChartUnit_zero`, `cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum_zero` — at exponent `a = 0`
    23	  the theta twisting cocycle is trivial, so the whole-chart theta datum has class `1`
    24	  **over an arbitrary test ring** (the worksheet cites the base-`k` class law
    25	  `cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum` + `fiberTwist_zero`; the direct `a = 0` computation
    26	  is ring-generic, which the §2 consumers need — recorded deviation).
    27	* `DivisorAdaptation.divisorDatum` — **the divisor datum**
    28	  `(A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv`, with class law
    29	  `cechPicClass_divisorDatum : A.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = d.picClass`
    30	  (G-0a at `a = 0` + the trivial theta block + `cechPicClass_inv`).
    31	* `DivisorAdaptation.canonSection` — **the canonical section is the equation system
    32	  itself** (N2): the components `(A.eqn j)` satisfy the inverse-datum matching
    33	  condition (`eqn_mul_eqnRatio` read against the inverted units), giving a global
    34	  section of the divisor datum's glued sheaf.
    35	* `DivisorAdaptation.divEq_sectionLocalEquations_canonSection` — **(N2) cut-back by
    36	  pure refinement**: the `LocalEquations` datum cut by `canonSection` (DAT-A
    37	  `sectionLocalEquations`, on any subordinated pointed cover) is `DivEq` to `d` —
    38	  the comparison units are the adaptation's own `eqn_rel` units; no fibre argument.
    39	-/
    40	
    41	set_option autoImplicit false
    42	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    43	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    44	
    45	universe u
    46	
    47	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    48	open CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
    49	
    50	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    51	
    52	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    53	
    54	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    55	  [Algebra k B]
    56	
    57	/-! ## The datum inverse -/
    58	
    59	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    60	
    61	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
    62	
    63	/-- The pair value of an inverse unit cocycle is the inverse pair value. -/
    64	private lemma inv_unitsEvInf {X : Scheme.{u}} {𝒰 : X.PointedCover}
    65	    (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
    66	    Scheme.unitsEvInf γ⁻¹ i j = (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ i j)⁻¹ := rfl
    67	
    68	/-- The unit-level cocycle identity of a datum (the value-level law `mul_res`
    69	re-packaged through `Units.ext`). -/
    70	private lemma unitsRestrict_unit_mul (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
    71	    (i j l : D.index) :
    72	    (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
    73	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    74	        (D.unit i j)
    75	      * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    76	          (D.unit j l)
    77	      = (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    78	          (D.unit i l) :=
    79	  Units.ext (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
    80	
    81	/-- **The datum inverse** (worksheet GAP-1): the same basic-open cover data with the
    82	termwise-inverted transition units `(g i j)⁻¹`. The cocycle law inverts termwise —
    83	the units are honest `Units`, and the section rings are commutative. -/
    84	noncomputable def inv (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) :
    85	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π where
    86	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData
    87	  unit i j := (D.unit i j)⁻¹
    88	  isGluingCocycle := by
    89	    constructor
    90	    · intro i
    91	      rw [show D.unit i i = 1 from Units.ext (D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i), inv_one,
    92	        Units.val_one]
    93	    · intro i j l
    94	      have key : ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
    95	            (inf_le_left :
    96	              D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    97	            (D.unit i j))⁻¹
    98	          * ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    99	              (D.unit j l))⁻¹
   100	          = ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   101	              (D.unit i l))⁻¹ := by
   102	        rw [← mul_inv]
   103	        exact congrArg (·⁻¹) (D.unitsRestrict_unit_mul i j l)
   104	      have hval := congrArg Units.val key
   105	      rw [Units.val_mul] at hval
   106	      exact hval
   107	
   108	@[simp]
   109	lemma inv_pieces (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) : D.inv.pieces = D.pieces := rfl
   110	
   111	@[simp]
   112	lemma inv_unit (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (i j : D.index) :
   113	    D.inv.unit i j = (D.unit i j)⁻¹ := rfl
   114	
   115	/-- **The class law of the datum inverse**: `[D⁻¹] = [D]⁻¹`. Both classes are computed
   116	by subordinated cocycles on `D`'s canonical pointed cover by pieces, where the
   117	subordinated cocycle of the inverse datum is the inverse cocycle. -/
   118	theorem cechPicClass_inv (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) :
   119	    D.inv.cechPicClass = D.cechPicClass⁻¹ := by
   120	  have hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B,
   121	      D.pointedCover.opens x ≤ D.inv.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   122	    fun _ => le_rfl
   123	  have hco : gluedSubordCocycle D.inv.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex hσ
   124	      = (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   125	          (fun _ => le_rfl))⁻¹ := by
   126	    refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
   127	    rw [gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, inv_unitsEvInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
   128	    exact Units.ext rfl
   129	  calc D.inv.cechPicClass
   130	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   131	          (gluedSubordCocycle D.inv.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   132	            hσ).class :=
   133	        (D.inv.cechPicClass_eq_mk D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex hσ).symm
   134	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   135	          ((gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   136	            (fun _ => le_rfl)).class)⁻¹ := by
   137	        rw [hco, OneCocycle.class_inv]
   138	    _ = D.cechPicClass⁻¹ := rfl
   139	
   140	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   141	
   142	/-! ## The theta block is trivial at exponent zero -/
   143	
   144	section ThetaZero
   145	
   146	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
   147	
   148	/-- The relative theta cocycle at exponent `0` is the trivial unit: `t₀⁰ = 1`. -/
   149	theorem relThetaCocycle_zero : relThetaCocycle C B π 0 = 1 := by
   150	  change relUnitCocycle C B (fiberTwoCover π) (thetaUnit π ^ 0) = 1
   151	  rw [pow_zero]
   152	  exact map_one _
   153	
   154	/-- The theta twisting units of a finite cover datum are trivial at exponent `0`. -/
   155	theorem FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero (D : FinCoverData C B π) (i j : D.index) :
   156	    D.thetaOvlUnit 0 i j = 1 := by
   157	  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
   158	  · rfl
   159	  · rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inl_inr, relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one]
   160	  · rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inr_inl, relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one, inv_one]
   161	  · rfl
   162	
   163	/-- The whole-chart theta transition units are trivial at exponent `0`. -/
   164	theorem thetaChartUnit_zero (i j : (thetaChartCover C B π).index) :
   165	    thetaChartUnit C B π 0 i j = 1 := by
   166	  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
   167	  · rfl
   168	  · change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _ (relThetaCocycle C B π 0) = 1
   169	    rw [relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one]
   170	  · change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _ (relThetaCocycle C B π 0)⁻¹ = 1
   171	    rw [relThetaCocycle_zero, inv_one, map_one]
   172	  · rfl
   173	
   174	/-- **The whole-chart theta datum has trivial class at exponent `0`, over an arbitrary
   175	test ring**: all its transition units are `1`, so the subordinated cocycle is the
   176	trivial cocycle. (Ring-generic strengthening of the base-`k` route
   177	`cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum` + `fiberTwist_zero`.) -/
   178	theorem cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum_zero :
   179	    (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).cechPicClass = 1 := by
   180	  have hco : gluedSubordCocycle (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).isGluingCocycle
   181	      (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pointedCover (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex
   182	      (fun _ => le_rfl) = 1 := by
   183	    refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
   184	    rw [gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, Scheme.one_unitsEvInf]
   185	    change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _
   186	        (thetaChartUnit C B π 0 ((thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex x)
   187	          ((thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex y)) = 1
   188	    rw [thetaChartUnit_zero, map_one]
   189	  change Scheme.CechPic.mk (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pointedCover
   190	      (gluedSubordCocycle (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).isGluingCocycle
   191	        (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pointedCover (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex
   192	        (fun _ => le_rfl)).class = 1
   193	  rw [hco, OneCocycle.class_one, Scheme.CechPic.mk_one]
   194	
   195	end ThetaZero
   196	
   197	/-! ## The divisor datum and its class law -/
   198	
   199	namespace DivisorAdaptation
   200	
   201	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   202	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
   203	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
   204	
   205	/-- The ideal transition units at exponent `0` are the plain ratio units `f_j/f_i`:
   206	the theta block is trivial. -/
   207	theorem thetaIdealUnit_zero (i j : A.index) :
   208	    A.thetaIdealUnit 0 i j = A.eqnRatio i j := by
   209	  rw [thetaIdealUnit, A.toFinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero, mul_one]
   210	
   211	/-- **The divisor datum of an adaptation** (worksheet GAP-1): the inverse of the
   212	twisted ideal datum at exponent `0` — a pinned cocycle datum in the class `[𝒪(d)]`
   213	(`cechPicClass_divisorDatum`), whose transition units are the inverted ratio units
   214	`(f_j/f_i)⁻¹`. -/
   215	noncomputable def divisorDatum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R π :=
   216	  (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv
   217	
   218	/-- **The class law of the divisor datum**: `[divisorDatum] = [𝒪(d)]` — G-0a at
   219	`a = 0`, the trivial theta block, and the class law of the datum inverse. -/
   220	theorem cechPicClass_divisorDatum : A.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = d.picClass := by
   221	  change (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv.cechPicClass = d.picClass
   222	  rw [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_inv, A.cechPicClass_thetaIdealDatum 0,
   223	    cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum_zero, one_mul, inv_inv]
   224	
   225	/-! ### The canonical section -/
   226	
   227	/-- The value-level matching law of the equation components against the inverted ratio
   228	units: `f_i = (f_j/f_i)⁻¹ · f_j` on any open below the piece overlap. -/
   229	private lemma res_eqn_eq_inv_eqnRatio_mul (i j : A.index) {O : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   230	    (hO : O ≤ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) :
   231	    (relCurve C R).resHom (hO.trans inf_le_left) (A.eqn i)
   232	      = (relCurve C R).resHom hO
   233	          (((A.eqnRatio i j)⁻¹ : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)ˣ) :
   234	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j))
   235	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (hO.trans inf_le_right) (A.eqn j) := by
   236	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom hO) (A.eqn_mul_eqnRatio i j)
   237	  rw [map_mul] at key
   238	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   239	  -- key : `res f_i · res (f_j/f_i) = res f_j` on `O`; divide by the restricted unit
   240	  refine (Units.eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq
   241	    ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hO (A.eqnRatio i j))).mpr ?_
   242	  rw [mul_comm]
   243	  exact key
   244	
   245	/-- The matching condition of the equation components for the divisor datum, in the
   246	exact shape of the `gluedSubmodule` carrier at `W = ⊤` (adaptation-index form; each
   247	datum-index case is definitionally this statement). -/
   248	private lemma canon_matching (i j : A.index) :
   249	    (relCurve C R).resHom
   250	        (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i)
   251	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i))
   252	      = (relCurve C R).resHom
   253	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
   254	            ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)
   255	          (((A.thetaIdealUnit 0 i j)⁻¹ :
   256	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)ˣ) :
   257	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j))
   258	        * (relCurve C R).resHom
   259	            (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   260	              ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces j)
   261	            ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces j)
   262	              (A.eqn j)) := by
   263	  rw [A.thetaIdealUnit_zero i j]
   264	  have key := A.res_eqn_eq_inv_eqnRatio_mul i j
   265	    (O := ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)
   266	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right)
   267	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   268	  exact key
   269	
   270	/-- **The canonical section of the divisor datum is the equation system itself**
   271	(worksheet §2 (N2)): the components `A.eqn j`, restricted to the pieces, form a
   272	matching family for the inverted ratio units — a global section of the divisor
   273	datum's glued sheaf. -/
   274	noncomputable def canonSection :
   275	    ↥(_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubmodule R A.divisorDatum.pieces
   276	        A.divisorDatum.unit ⊤) :=
   277	  ⟨fun j => (relCurve C R).resHom
   278	      (inf_le_right.trans (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j)))
   279	      (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)),
   280	    by
   281	      intro i j
   282	      rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
   283	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inl j.down)
   284	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr j.down)
   285	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inr i.down) (Sum.inl j.down)
   286	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inr i.down) (Sum.inr j.down)⟩
   287	
   288	/-- The components of the canonical section are the (piece-restricted) equations. -/
   289	lemma component_canonSection (j : (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index) :
   290	    A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j
   291	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j))
   292	          (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) :=
   293	  Scheme.resHom_resHom _ _ _
   294	
   295	/-- The canonical section is germ-regular: its components are the adaptation's own
   296	regular equations (`eqn_regular`) — the `hreg` input of `sectionLocalEquations`,
   297	with no fibrewise hypothesis. -/
   298	theorem germ_component_canonSection_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   299	    (j : (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index) (y : relCurve C R)
   300	    (hy : y ∈ A.divisorDatum.pieces j) :
   301	    ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.divisorDatum.pieces j) y hy).hom
   302	        (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j)
   303	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk y) := by
   304	  have hy' : y ∈ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 j) :=
   305	    (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j)) hy
   306	  have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.divisorDatum.pieces j) y hy).hom
   307	      (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j)
   308	      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) y hy').hom
   309	          (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) := by
   310	    rw [A.component_canonSection j]
   311	    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   312	  rw [hswap]
   313	  exact A.eqn_regular (A.lowerIndex 0 j) y hy'
   314	
   315	/-- **(N2) — the canonical section cuts back `d` by pure refinement**: the
   316	`LocalEquations` datum cut by the canonical section on any pointed cover subordinated
   317	to the pieces is `DivEq` to `d`. The common refinement is `𝒲 ⊓ d.cover`, and the
   318	comparison units are the adaptation's own `eqn_rel` units (`relUnit`) — no fibre
   319	argument anywhere. -/
   320	theorem divEq_sectionLocalEquations_canonSection
   321	    (𝒲 : (relCurve C R).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C R → (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index)
   322	    (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C R, 𝒲.opens y ≤ A.divisorDatum.pieces (σ y)) :
   323	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
   324	      (A.divisorDatum.sectionLocalEquations A.canonSection 𝒲 σ hσ
   325	        (fun j y hy => A.germ_component_canonSection_mem_nonZeroDivisors j y hy))
   326	      d := by
   327	  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ d.cover, fun x => inf_le_left, fun x => inf_le_right, fun x => ?_⟩
   328	  -- the piece through `x` sits inside the adaptation piece of its lowered index
   329	  have hpc : 𝒲.opens x ≤ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) :=
   330	    (hσ x).trans (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 (σ x)))
   331	  have hle : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x
   332	      ≤ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) ⊓ d.cover.opens x :=
   333	    inf_le_inf_right _ hpc
   334	  refine ⟨(relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hle (A.relUnit (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) x), ?_⟩
   335	  -- the defining equation of the comparison unit, restricted to the refinement
   336	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom hle)
   337	    (A.res_eqn_eq_relUnit_mul (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) x)
   338	  rw [map_mul] at key
   339	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   340	  -- collapse the constructed datum's restricted equation onto the adaptation
   341	  -- equation, term-mode (`rw` walks into the relCurve spelling seam — I-0237(a))
   342	  have hlhs := (Scheme.resHom_resHom (hσ x)
   343	      (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)
   344	      (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection (σ x))).trans
   345	    ((congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   346	        ((inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x).trans (hσ x)))
   347	      (A.component_canonSection (σ x))).trans
   348	      (Scheme.resHom_resHom (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 (σ x)))
   349	        ((inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x).trans (hσ x))
   350	        (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)))))
   351	  exact hlhs.trans key
   352

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/
    37	
    38	set_option autoImplicit false
    39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    40	
    41	universe u
    42	
    43	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    44	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    45	
    46	open scoped TensorProduct
    47	
    48	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    49	
    50	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    51	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    52	
    53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    54	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    55	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    56	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    57	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    58	
    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    93	
    94	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    95	
    96	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    97	
    98	noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
   100	    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
   101	  Scheme.moduleKSections
   102	    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U
   103	
   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
   111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   112	  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   114	
   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
   121	      P.module :=
   122	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module
   124	
   125	/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/
   126	
   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)
   143	
   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))
   160	
   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module
   210	
   211	/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.
   212	
   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   231	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))
   235	
   236	/-! ## The datum/native-section/evaluation bridge -/
   237	
   238	/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
   239	noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   240	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   241	    P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens)) :=
   242	  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   243	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   244	    isTerminalTop P.datum.sheaf y
   245	
   246	/-! The datum-side section after coefficient extension.  This deliberately stops at the
   247	glued cocycle sheaf; identifying it with native `Scheme.Modules` global sections is a
   248	separate contract and is not smuggled in here. -/
   249	noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   250	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   251	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   252	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   253	    (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
   254	      (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
   255	  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   256	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   257	    isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf
   258	    (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y))
   259	
   260	/-- H⁰ base change transports the tied datum section to the canonical glued-section map. -/
   261	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   262	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   263	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   264	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   265	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y =
   266	      P.datum.sectionsMapTop B (P.datumSection y) := by
   267	  exact P.datum.linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul B
   268	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing) y
   269	
   270	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
   271	
   272	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   273	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
   274	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
   275	irreducible curve hypotheses.
   276	-/
   277	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange

   383	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the

   386	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   387	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   388	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/

   390	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   392	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   404	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)
   409	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h

   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom

   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom

   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho

   574	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

   577	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   578	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   579	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   580	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   581	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   582	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   583	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   584	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom

   627	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass
   628	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   629	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   630	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   631	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   632	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   633	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   634	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   635	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   636	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass =
   637	      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
   638	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   639	  exact P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange_picClass
   640	    (Localization.Away f) y
   641	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)

   647	Re-key the standard base-change bundle locally before stating the degree theorem. -/

   678	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   679	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   680	
   681	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   682	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   683	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   684	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   685	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   686	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   687	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   688	    classDeg L
   689	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   690	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   691	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   692	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   693	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   694	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   695	  have hcurve :
   696	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   697	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   698	    refine congrArg
   699	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   700	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   701	  have hpresentation :
   702	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   703	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   704	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   705	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   706	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   707	  calc
   708	    classDeg L
   709	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   710	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   711	      relPicDeg L
   712	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   713	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   714	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   715	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   716	    _ = relPicDeg L
   717	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   718	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   719	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   720	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   721	      rfl
   722	    _ = relPicDeg L
   723	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   724	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   725	      rw [P.datum_class]
   726	    _ = degAt
   727	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   728	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   729	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   730	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   731	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   732	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   733	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   734	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   735	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   736	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
   738	
   739	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

     9	/-!
    10	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    11	
    12	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    13	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    14	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    15	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    16	
    17	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    18	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    19	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u

    27	  CartesianMonoidalCategory

    76	/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/
    77	
    78	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    79	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    80	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    81	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    82	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    83	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    84	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    85	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    86	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    87	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    88	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    89	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    90	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    91	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    92	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    93	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    94	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    95	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    96	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
    99	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   101	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
   102	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
   103	  let B := Localization.Away f
   104	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   105	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   106	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   107	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   108	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   109	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   110	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
   111	  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   112	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   113	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   114	      s q (hsec q) j
   115	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   116	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   117	    s hfib L z

   119	/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The
   120	calculation uses the datum class law and datum_classDeg_baseChange, so the degree is tied to
   121	the presentation rather than supplied as an unrelated witness. -/
   122	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg
   123	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   124	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   125	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   126	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   127	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   128	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   129	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   130	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   131	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   132	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
   133	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :
   134	    classDeg L
   135	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   136	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
   137	  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
   138	    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
   139	      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
   140	  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
   141	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
   142	  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
   143	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
   144	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   145	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f),
   146	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (Localization.Away f) L])
   147	  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
   148	    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
   149	    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
   150	    relCurveMap_comp]
   151	  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L

   155	/-- The widened divisor cut by a tied rank-one section on its basic open. -/
   156	noncomputable def baseOpenRankOneDivisor
   157	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   158	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   159	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   160	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   161	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   162	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   163	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   164	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   165	    DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) (genus C) :=
   166	  divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations C (genus C)
   167	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) pi
   168	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular f y hy)
   169	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg f y hy)

   187	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   188	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   189	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   190	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   191	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   192	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   193	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   194	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   195	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   196	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   197	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   198	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   199	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   200	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   201	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   202	  let B := Localization.Away f
   203	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   204	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   205	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   206	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   207	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   208	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   209	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   210	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   211	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   212	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   213	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   214	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   215	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   216	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   217	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
   218	    rfl
   219	  calc
   220	    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
   221	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
   222	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
   223	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
   224	      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   225	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   226	      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
   227	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   228	      congr 1
   229	      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   230	
   231	/-- Every base point of a rank-one presentation has a tied local widened divisor.  The final
   232	conjunct retains the native counit identity for the very same section. -/
   233	theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation
   234	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   235	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   236	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   237	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   238	      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   239	        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   240	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   241	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   242	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
   243	        (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
   244	            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
   245	          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   246	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   247	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   248	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   249	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, heval⟩ := P.exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator p
   250	  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy, heval⟩
   251	
   252	/-- Every base point has one tied local divisor whose Abel value is the restriction of the
   253	input class and whose defining section satisfies the native evaluation identity. -/
   254	theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
   255	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   256	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   257	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   258	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   259	      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   260	        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   261	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   262	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   263	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
   264	        abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   265	            PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   266	              ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   267	              (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   268	                (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) ∧
   269	          (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
   270	              (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
   271	            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   272	              ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   273	                (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   274	              (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   275	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, hclass, heval⟩ :=
   276	    P.exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation p
   277	  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff f y hy, hclass, heval⟩

     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	variable (C n) in
    42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55	
    56	variable (C n) in
    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	variable (C) in
    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.
    81	
    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    85	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# DAT-C C2 — the rank-1 H⁰ export and the generator kit
    13	(`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-3 Σ-RANK1, §2 (N1)/(N3))
    14	
    15	On the fibrewise h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization
    16	`χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`, the datum engine's `H⁰` is an **invertible** module: finite,
    17	projective, and of stalk-rank exactly `1`.  This is the rank export the engine
    18	(`datumRigidEngine`, `Cohomology/GluedSheafEngine.lean`) leaves open — it delivers
    19	finite + projective, never `rankAtStalk = 1`.
    20	
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chi_relCurve` — the χ transport `χ(𝒪_{C_L}) = 1 − n` to every
    22	  field `L` of the test tower (base-field invariance of the genus, `chi_moduleKSheaf`
    23	  + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the private lemma of `DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel`).
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one` — **the fibre
    25	  computation**: for a datum whose fibre class over `L` has `classDeg = n`, with `H¹` of
    26	  the base-changed sheaf vanishing, `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1` — the Riemann–Roch anchor
    27	  `h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` (`n + (1 − n)`) read through the presentation
    28	  bridge `presentationSheafIso`.  The fibre geometric package is threaded as instance
    29	  arguments (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`).
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` — **Σ-RANK1,
    31	  the datum-level export**: on the vanishing locus (fibre degree `n`, `χ = 1 − n`),
    32	  `Module.rankAtStalk (H⁰(F_D)) p = 1`.  Route: `Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as
    33	  the `κ(p)`-fibre dimension; `datumH0BaseChange` (on the nose) identifies the fibre with
    34	  `H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`; the fibre computation above pins it at `1`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one` — the
    36	  certified-family specialization (**N1**): for `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus
    37	  `V`, the divisor datum `D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has invertible `H⁰`.  The
    38	  fibre-degree hypothesis is discharged uniformly by `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass` (the
    39	  fibre class has `classDeg = n` at every field).
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum`
    41	  — **N3, the generator kit**: since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of rank `1` (hence has a
    42	  nontrivial fibre at every prime of the locus), a fibrewise-nonzero **global** section
    43	  exists Zariski-locally (`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`).
    44	
    45	Noetherian discipline (worksheet §2): every rank statement carries `[IsNoetherianRing S]`
    46	through the engine; the arbitrary-test consumers reach it through RE-5 stages.
    47	-/
    48	
    49	set_option autoImplicit false
    50	/- Statements mix `relCurve C L` with the product spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`. -/
    51	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    52	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161). -/
    53	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    54	
    55	universe u
    56	
    57	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    58	open scoped TensorProduct
    59	
    60	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    61	
    62	open AlgebraicJacobian Scheme
    63	
    64	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    65	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    66	
    67	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    68	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    69	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] {n : ℕ}
    70	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    71	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    72	
    73	/-- The standing `C.left`-over-`k` structure, keyed on `C.hom` — the instance the base
    74	χ-normalization `hχ : χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n` is phrased against (defeq to `.ofHom C.hom`, so
    75	`chi_moduleKSheaf C` unifies with it). -/
    76	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftRankOne : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    77	
    78	/-! ## The χ transport to the fibre curve -/
    79	
    80	/-- **`χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` at every field extension**, from the base normalization
    81	(`chi_moduleKSheaf` at the base-changed bundle + `genus_baseField`; a re-derivation of the
    82	`DivSchemeMonoBridgeRel` private lemma). -/
    83	theorem chi_relCurve (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
    84	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    85	    Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (n : ℤ) := by
    86	  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
    87	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    88	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
    89	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    90	    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
    91	  have h1 : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L)
    92	      = 1 - (genus (baseChangeBundle C L) : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf (baseChangeBundle C L)
    93	  have h2 : genus (baseChangeBundle C L) = genus C := genus_baseField C L
    94	  have h3 : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) := chi_moduleKSheaf C
    95	  have h4 : (genus C : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) := by rw [h3] at hχ; linarith
    96	  rw [h1, h2, h4]
    97	
    98	/-! ## The fibre computation: `h⁰(C_L, F_{D_L}) = 1`
    99	
   100	The fibre geometric instances (`Curve.BaseChangeInstances`) are threaded as instance
   101	arguments — they cannot be synthesized through the `relCurve` `def` barrier, so consumers
   102	install them by `haveI` (the `degAt_abelDiv` block, I-0249 (iv)) before calling. -/
   103	
   104	/-- **The fibre h⁰ pin**: for a datum whose fibre class over the field `L` has
   105	`classDeg = n`, with the base χ-normalization and vanishing `H¹` of the base-changed
   106	sheaf, the fibre global-section count is exactly `1` — the Riemann–Roch rank anchor
   107	`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` read through the presentation bridge
   108	`presentationSheafIso`, at `n + (1 − n)`. -/
   109	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one
   110	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π)
   111	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   112	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra S L] [IsScalarTower k S L]
   113	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
   114	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   115	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
   116	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
   117	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
   118	    (hg : classDeg L (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ))
   119	    (hsub : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange L).sheaf 1)) :
   120	    Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = 1 := by
   121	  set P : (relCurve C L).MeromorphicPresentation :=
   122	    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (D.baseChange L).pointedCover
   123	      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange L).isGluingCocycle
   124	        (D.baseChange L).pointedCover (D.baseChange L).pieceIndex
   125	        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
   126	  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf L) 1) :=
   127	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L)) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp
   128	      hsub
   129	  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf L) :=
   130	    Sheaf.h0_congr (presentationSheafIso (D.baseChange L))
   131	  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi L P hsubP
   132	  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange L).cechPicClass := rfl
   133	  have hint : (Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange L).sheaf : ℤ) = 1 := by
   134	    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hg, chi_relCurve hχ L]; ring
   135	  exact_mod_cast hint
   136	
   137	/-! ## Σ-RANK1: the rank-1 export on the vanishing locus -/
   138	
   139	/-- **Σ-RANK1, the datum-level rank export** (worksheet GAP-3): on the fibrewise
   140	h¹-vanishing locus, at fibre degree `n` with the base χ-normalization `χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n`,
   141	the datum engine's `H⁰` has stalk-rank exactly `1` at `p`.
   142	
   143	`Module.rankAtStalk_eq` reads the rank as the `κ(p)`-dimension of the fibre
   144	`κ(p) ⊗[S] H⁰`; the on-the-nose base change `datumH0BaseChange` identifies this fibre with
   145	`H⁰(C_{κ(p)}, F_{D_{κ(p)}})`, whose dimension is `1` by the fibre computation. The global
   146	fibrewise hypothesis `hfib` supplies finiteness/projectivity (hence flatness) through
   147	`datumRigidEngine`. -/
   148	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one
   149	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S π) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   150	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   151	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   152	    (hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   153	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
   154	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   155	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   156	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   157	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   158	    [QuasiCompact
   159	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   160	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   161	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   162	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   163	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)]
   164	    (hg : classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   165	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ)) :
   166	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   167	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine D hπ hfib
   168	  haveI := hfin
   169	  haveI := hproj
   170	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1 := datum_subsingleton_pairH1 D hπ hfib
   171	  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 :=
   172	    D.h0_sheaf_baseChange_eq_one hχ p.asIdeal.ResidueField hg
   173	      (D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1)
   174	  calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
   175	      = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   176	          (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
   177	        Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
   178	    _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   179	          (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
   180	        (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
   181	    _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
   182	    _ = 1 := hfibre
   183	
   184	/-! ## The certified-family specialization: N1 (invertible `H⁰`) and N3 (generators) -/
   185	
   186	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   187	/-- (Implementation) The fibre class of the divisor datum has `classDeg = n` at `κ(p)`:
   188	the base change of `G.eqns`, read through `DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`. -/
   189	private theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum
   190	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
   191	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   192	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   193	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   194	    [QuasiCompact
   195	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField))]
   196	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   197	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0)]
   198	    [Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   199	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1)] :
   200	    classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   201	      (G.adaptation.divisorDatum.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (n : ℤ) := by
   202	  have hcl : G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = (DivFam.mk G).toZar.picClass := by
   203	    rw [G.adaptation.cechPicClass_divisorDatum, DivFamZar.picClass_toZar, DivFam.picClass_mk]
   204	  rw [G.adaptation.divisorDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField, hcl,
   205	    ← DivFamZar.picClass_mapAlg]
   206	  exact DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass
   207	    (DivFamZar.mapAlg p.asIdeal.ResidueField n (DivFam.mk G).toZar)
   208	
   209	/-- **N1 — invertibility of the canonical `H⁰`** (worksheet §2 (N1)): for a certified
   210	divisor family `G` landing in the h¹-vanishing locus `V` (`hvan`), the divisor datum
   211	`D_G := G.adaptation.divisorDatum` has `H⁰` of stalk-rank exactly `1` at every prime.
   212	
   213	The fibre-degree hypothesis of `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one` is discharged uniformly:
   214	the fibre class of `D_G` at `κ(p)` is the base change of `G.eqns`, which has
   215	`classDeg = n` at every field (`DivFamZar.classDeg_picClass`). -/
   216	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one
   217	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   218	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   219	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   220	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   221	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   222	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   223	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   224	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   225	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)
   226	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   227	    instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   228	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   229	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   230	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   231	  haveI : QuasiCompact
   232	      (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   233	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   234	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   235	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   236	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   237	  haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   238	      (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   239	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   240	  exact G.adaptation.divisorDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one hπ hχ hfib p
   241	    (G.classDeg_baseChange_divisorDatum p)
   242	
   243	/-- **N3 — the generator kit** (worksheet §2 (N3)): since `H⁰(F_{D_G})` is projective of
   244	stalk-rank `1` on the locus, its `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial, so a fibrewise-nonzero
   245	**global** section exists on a basic open `D(f) ∋ p` — the Zariski-local generator
   246	(`Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective`, the Nakayama-neighbourhood kit of
   247	`Picard/LocalGenerators.lean`). -/
   248	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.exists_fibrewise_generator_divisorDatum
   249	    (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C S π n) [IsNoetherianRing S]
   250	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   251	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (n : ℤ))
   252	    (hvan : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S, (DivFam.mk G).toZar.IsH1VanishingAt p)
   253	    (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
   254	    ∃ f : S, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ ∃ q : Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0,
   255	      ∀ q' : PrimeSpectrum S, f ∉ q'.asIdeal →
   256	        (q ⊗ₜ (1 : q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   257	            Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S] q'.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
   258	  have hfib : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
   259	      Subsingleton ((datumPair G.adaptation.divisorDatum).H1 ⊗[S] q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   260	    fun q => (G.isH1VanishingAt_toZar_iff q).mp (hvan q)
   261	  obtain ⟨-, hfin, hproj⟩ := datumRigidEngine G.adaptation.divisorDatum hπ hfib
   262	  haveI := hfin
   263	  haveI := hproj
   264	  have hrank : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) p = 1 :=
   265	    G.rankAtStalk_divisorDatum_eq_one hπ hχ hvan p
   266	  -- rank 1 ⟹ the `κ(p)`-fibre is nontrivial
   267	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   268	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) = 1 := by
   269	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]; exact hrank
   270	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S]
   271	      Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0) :=
   272	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   273	  have hnt : Nontrivial (Sheaf.HModule G.adaptation.divisorDatum.sheaf 0 ⊗[S]
   274	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   275	    (TensorProduct.comm S _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   276	  exact Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p hnt

    11	
    12	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    13	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    14	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    15	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    16	
    17	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    18	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    19	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
